title: [Monograph G02] Running-coupling integration: match the shooting slope s_G and derive the public running input
body:
## Bounded integration task (package G02)

Parent: #26 (unit YM-000026). Coordinator: @hairer. Task document: `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/G02.md`. Source pin: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base branch: `codex/existence-monograph` (bac6004).

G02.md assigns the running-coupling integration contract to the live issue #22. #22 was closed at 12:14 UTC today after the canonical unit YM-000022 was revised and reviewed, but the G02 part was never done: `results/G02/` does not exist. Two later records name it as still open:
- G04-F1, second half (`results/G04/findings.md`; #60): the shooting slope $s_G$ in `common-scale-selection.tex` and `surviving-interval-shooting.tex` is only said to be positive.
- G05 (`results/G05/g04-crosswalk.md` row Step 4, `semantic-register.md` C16 row; #61): "Do not identify $s_G$ with $\lambda_G=2b_0$ by notation. The owner must match the actual slope, same history and uniformity."

C10 revision 2 (#131) already settled $C_G=C_{\mathfrak g}$, so $\lambda_G=11C_G/(24\pi^2)=2b_0(G)$.

## Scope

1. **Slope.** Match $s_G$, as used in `surviving-interval-shooting.tex`, `common-scale-selection.tex`, `rg-construction.tex`, `physical-reset-reorganization.tex`, `finite-menu-history-handoff.tex`, `common-funded-history.tex`, `common-observable-purchases.tex` and `selected-nonlinear-offering.tex`, against $\lambda_G$ (C10, `background-path-convergence.tex`, `path-attachment-producer.tex`) and against the source (`YM.Gauge.slopeConstant`, `YM.RG.Calendar.hatBeta`, `YM.Pressure.betaF`, `YM.RG.Transfer`). Check that every chapter means the same constant.
2. **Same history and uniformity.** Check that the shooting estimate (`eq:shoot-running-error` and the following $o(S_i)$ bound) supplies the hypothesis `eq:running` of `sec:running-coefficient` exactly: the same coefficients $\beta_{N,p,m}$, the same intercept, block factors at least 3, and uniformity in $N\ge m$ and $p$ (source `YM.RG.Running`, `YM.RG.Selected.running`).
3. **$N=m$ specialization.** Derive the public condition `ex-running-input` with $\sigma=2b_0(G)$ from `prop:uniform-extraction` at $m=N$, using bare coefficient $=\beta_{N,p,N}$ and public spacing $a_N=e^{-s_N}$ (source `YangMills.regular`, `YM.Pert.Asymptotics.zeroUp_bound`, `YM.Family.beta`, `YM.Lattice.Schedule.scale`).
4. Integrator instructions for including `sec:running-coefficient` in `existence.tex`, and the bibliography check.

## Owned outputs

- `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/G02/` (report, ledger, proposed patches).

No edits to chapters, the canonical unit YM-000022 or its reviews, `existence.tex`, the preamble, the glossary, `references.bib` or Lean. Following G02.md, every chapter change goes in the report as an exact proposed patch for its owner or for F01. The text of each proposed patch is mathematical LaTeX, ready to apply.

## Readiness and acceptance

Ready: #22 is closed with no live claim, and YM-000022 has its reviews. C10 rev. 2 is merged. G05 is delivered. The G04 finalization claim (#60, TrishenGunaratnam) owns only `argument-outline.tex` and `results/G04/`, which this task does not touch. Post and recheck a separate claim before work.

Acceptance: every $s_G$ occurrence is classified against the source. The $N=m$ argument is complete. Each patch is exact and tested by a build of the patched monograph in a scratch tree. The blueprint checker and tests pass. One focused draft PR against `codex/existence-monograph`, with a handoff here and pointers on #26 and #60. This is new prose, so it needs independent review by another account. No merge or publication.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
